'''Uxiol Droid Manufacturing''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]]-producing company that was based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hallion]]. Uxiol maintained a [[Uxiol Droid Manufacturing plant|manufacturing plant]] on Hallion.
